bib.title: Noise2Music: Text-conditioned Music Generation with Diffusion Models

question: Can a cascade of text-conditioned diffusion models, trained on LLM/MuLan pseudo-labelled audio, generate high-quality 30-second music clips from free-form text?
contributions: Cascaded 1D U-Net diffusion models (generator + cascader/vocoder + super-resolution) with two intermediate representations: 3.2kHz waveform or log-mel spectrogram
Pseudo-labelling pipeline using LaMDA-generated caption vocabularies and MuLan zero-shot matching, annotating O(150K) hours
MuLaMCap dataset of O(400K) music-text pairs from AudioSet
Evaluation with FAD (three encoders), MuLan similarity and human listening tests, plus inference-parameter ablations

method.summary: Five 1D Efficient U-Net diffusion models are trained: waveform generator (3.2kHz) and cascader (16kHz), or spectrogram generator and vocoder (16kHz), plus a 24kHz super-resolution cascader. Text is encoded with a T5 encoder (non-pooled tokens) and fed by cross attention; training pairs come from ~6.8M soundtracks pseudo-labelled with LaMDA captions chosen by MuLan.
method.task: text-to-music generation with cascaded diffusion; inference sampling (denoising schedule, stochasticity, CFG scale)

datasets.name: Pseudo-labelled music corpus
datasets.size: ~6.8M source files, six 30-second clips each, nearly 340k hours; O(150K) hours annotated
datasets.source: music audio source files (internal; not otherwise described)
datasets.preprocessing: 24kHz for super-resolution model, 16kHz for others; labels: song title, named-entity tags, 3 pseudo labels from LaMDA-LF and 6 from Rater-SF; Rater-LF excluded to avoid MusicCaps leakage

datasets.name: Internal high-quality music library
datasets.source: internally maintained library, tracks not requiring attribution
datasets.preprocessing: non-overlapping 30-second clips; track metadata concatenated as the text prompt

datasets.name: MuLaMCap
datasets.size: 388,262 train / 4,497 test AudioSet music examples (O(400K) pairs)
datasets.source: AudioSet music subtree captioned by LaMDA+MuLan
datasets.preprocessing: per 10s clip: 3 LaMDA-LF, 3 Rater-LF, 6 Rater-SF captions

datasets.name: MusicCaps
datasets.preprocessing: rater captions as prompts; middle 10s of generated audio evaluated

datasets.name: AudioSet-Music-Eval
datasets.preprocessing: concatenated labels as prompt; 30s generated, middle 10s evaluated

datasets.name: MagnaTagATune
datasets.preprocessing: tags concatenated into one string; one 29s clip generated per example

other.note: size and whether frozen not stated

models.name: LaMDA
models.architecture: dialogue LLM used to write caption vocabulary

models.name: MuLan
models.architecture: contrastive text/audio joint embedding, 10-second audio windows

other.note: numbers quoted from Agostinelli et al.

training.objective: noise-prediction diffusion loss E[w_t ||eps_theta(x_t,c,t) - eps||^2]; simplified weight w_t=1 or sigma weight w_t=sigma_t^2; text dropped for 10% of batch samples for CFG
training.lr_schedule: cosine with end point at 2.5M steps
training.batch_size: 4096 for super-resolution cascader; 2048 for all other models
training.seq_len: generators trained on full 30s; cascaders and vocoder on 3 to 4 second random snippets
training.regularisation: EMA of parameters, decay 0.9999, used at inference; conditioning-noise augmentation (t_max 0.5 cascader, 1.0 vocoder and super-resolution); blur augmentation (1D kernel size 10, sigma 0.1 to 5.0 for cascader; 2D 5x5, sigma 0.2 to 1.0 for vocoder)
training.hardware: Google Cloud TPU V4 (serving); training hardware not stated

other.text_batch: three long prompts as independent elements, short prompts concatenated and segmented to the token length; one random element used per clip
other.variance_schedules: linear sigma0^2=0.0001, sigma1^2=0.02; cosine variant with lambda(0)=20, lambda(1)=-20
other.hyperparameter_selection: heuristic, by authors' judgement on a small dev prompt set

inference.decoding: ancestral (DDPM) sampling with stochasticity gamma, hand-tuned denoising step schedule, classifier-free guidance with dynamic clipping
inference.samples: one clip per prompt (21,638 for MTAT); four clips per serving request
inference.prompting: free-form text through T5 cross attention

parameters.steps: waveform generator 1000, cascader 800, spectrogram generator 1000, vocoder 100, super-res 800

metrics.name: FAD (VGG, Trill, MuLan encoders)
metrics.definition: Frechet distance between Gaussian fits of embeddings of generated vs reference audio

metrics.name: MuLan similarity
metrics.definition: cosine similarity between MuLan embeddings of generated audio and ground-truth text or audio, averaged

metrics.name: Human pairwise wins
metrics.definition: 5-point Likert: which of two 10s clips is better described by a MusicCaps caption; total wins per source

eval.protocol: single sample per prompt; human test 3k ratings, each source in 1.2k pairwise comparisons; no seeds or significance tests stated

limits: Authors caution that baselines may be disadvantaged: training data may be closer to the evaluation sets, and MuLan-based metrics may favour models trained on MuLan pseudo-labels.
Model and inference parameters were chosen heuristically by authors' judgement on a small private dev prompt set; ablations used less-trained checkpoints and varied one parameter at a time.
Models struggle on out-of-distribution prompts; examples on the demo page are cherry-picked.
Single sample per prompt, no seeds, error bars or significance tests; training hardware and compute not stated; training corpus is internal and not described.
Model not released due to safety and bias concerns; authors note possible misappropriation and cultural caricature harms.
Alternatives to T5 text embeddings not compared.
